clue.text: Uninterested but showing a way to quote back

parts.note: a path is a way or track

indicators.note: back tells us the word for quote is read from its end to its start

parts.note: to quote a source is to cite it

explanation.surface: Someone bored is nonetheless pointing out how to cite a passage.
explanation.definitionFit: Apathy is a lack of interest or concern, so an uninterested person is listless in this way.

clue.text: move the camera round and it's sensational

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held, 'move the camera round and it's sensational', gives PAN with nothing for the I that must go inside; a word such as 'one' appears to be missing and no scan is available.
annotationWithheld.clue: move the camera round and it's sensational

clue.text: A piece of furniture for young Longfellow?

definitions.meaning: read literally, a youngster who is a long fellow: a lanky lad

explanation.definitionFit: A tallboy is a high chest of drawers, and a lanky youngster is jokingly a tall lad.

clue.text: Groups of nine and seen from another angle

indicators.note: viewing the letters from another angle suggests rearranging them into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Sets of nine items are observed from a different viewpoint.
explanation.definitionFit: An ennead is a set of nine things, from the Greek for nine, so the plural names several such sets.

clue.text: Doctrines contained in one's writing

parts.note: one is I, so one's (one is) gives I plus S
MS is the abbreviation for manuscript, a piece of writing

explanation.surface: Principles a person sets down in their own written work.
explanation.definitionFit: An ism is a distinctive doctrine or ideology, so the plural covers several such belief systems.

clue.text: Call that's unexpected

parts.note: a call here is a visit paid to someone, and this one comes without warning

explanation.definitionFit: Dropping in on someone without notice is a call made unannounced, the sense of the phrase.

clue.text: Where a good man and his dog get the go-by in the 11

definitions.text: Where a good man and his dog get the go-by in the 11

parts.words: Where a good man and his dog get the go-by in the 11
parts.note: the good man is a saint whose name was given to a rescue dog breed; the go-by is a route past, in the mountains of 11 across

explanation.walkthrough: Answer 11 across is the ALPS. The Great St Bernard is a high route between Switzerland and Italy, named after the saint whose hospice bred the rescue dogs.
explanation.definitionFit: This Alpine crossing bears the saint's name, as does the famous breed of mountain rescue dog.

clue.text: Mean-spiritedness of one I must plainly reform

indicators.note: to reform is to reshape, so the letters before it are put into a new order

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A person admits their own pettiness and resolves openly to mend their ways.
explanation.definitionFit: Pusillanimity is timidity or lack of courage, a small-souled meanness of spirit.

clue.text: Struck by Elia disguised as Mr Heath

parts.note: Elia was the pen name behind which the essayist Charles Lamb disguised himself
Ted Heath, the former British Prime Minister Edward Heath

explanation.surface: Someone was hit by an essayist masquerading as a former Prime Minister.
explanation.walkthrough: Edward (Ted) Heath was British Prime Minister in the 1970s.
explanation.definitionFit: To lambast someone is to beat or thrash them, or to criticise them severely; struck is the past tense.

clue.text: Jenny used to, but that's another story

definitions.meaning: a spinning jenny was the machine used to make thread
telling a tall tale, a different story from the truth

explanation.definitionFit: A spinning jenny turned fibre into thread, and the idiom for telling a far-fetched tale uses the same phrase.

clue.text: Upon which individual records are made

definitions.text: Upon which individual records are made

parts.words: Upon which individual records are made
parts.note: records suggest discs, but these are solo climbing feats set on mountain peaks

explanation.definitionFit: Climbers set personal records ascending the peaks of this European mountain range.

clue.text: Vessel about to be refitted

indicators.note: a refit rebuilds a ship, so the letters of the preceding word are rebuilt in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A ship is about to undergo a refit.
explanation.definitionFit: A U-boat is a German submarine, a kind of seagoing craft.

clue.text: Look both ways

indicators.note: the word reads the same in both ways, from left to right and right to left

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Glance to the left and to the right before crossing.
explanation.definitionFit: A peep is a quick or furtive glance, so it is a kind of brief look.

clue.text: All lit up!

parts.note: suggests something illuminated or someone drunk, but means burning, on fire

explanation.definitionFit: Something ablaze is burning, which is a literal way of being lit.

clue.text: Resinous substance firm friend finds

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: A loyal friend discovers a sticky material.
explanation.definitionFit: Copal is a hard tree resin used in making varnish.

clue.text: Cheese parasite, but not for long

parts.note: Brie is a soft French cheese
a fly can be a parasite, as with botflies laying eggs in hosts

explanation.surface: An insect pest lands on a soft cheese but does not stay.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done for a short time is done briefly; both phrases mean momentarily.

clue.text: Bound to tell the truth

parts.note: bound sounds like certain or tied, but means committed by an oath, as a witness or new officeholder is

explanation.definitionFit: A witness takes an oath before testifying, after which they are obliged to be honest.

clue.text: Cut by listener in the outhouse

indicators.note: in places the word for listener inside the word for outhouse

parts.note: a shed is an outhouse or outbuilding
an ear is what one listens with

explanation.surface: Something was chopped by someone eavesdropping in a garden shed.
explanation.definitionFit: To shear is to clip or cut, as with sheep's wool; sheared is the past form.

clue.text: Acts winsomely to a soldier in the Norfolk market town

indicators.note: in puts the article and soldier inside the town's name

parts.note: Diss is a market town in Norfolk, in eastern England
RM stands for Royal Marine, a soldier at sea

explanation.surface: A soldier in a small English market town behaves charmingly.
explanation.definitionFit: To disarm someone is to win them over with charm, so the verb fits behaving winningly.

clue.text: Carrier for sucker fish

parts.note: a teat is what a suckling animal sucks
a ray is a flat fish

explanation.surface: A container for transporting a sucker fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea tray carries cups and pot from kitchen to table.

clue.text: Suffering of a number in low

indicators.note: in puts the article and number inside the word for low

parts.note: to trail is to hang low or drag along the ground
V is the Roman numeral five, a number

explanation.surface: Someone feeling down is in pain among many others.
explanation.definitionFit: Travail is painful toil or anguish, an old word for hardship.

clue.text: Base back at the start of 26

indicators.note: back means that first word of 26 across is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: 26 across begins with the word for happening in real time

explanation.surface: A foundation positioned behind the beginning of something.
explanation.definitionFit: Base as an adjective means low or wicked in morality, so it means wicked.

clue.text: Non-clerical island, apparently

parts.note: split the island's name into a verb meaning exists and a word meaning not of the clergy

explanation.definitionFit: This Hebridean island off western Scotland, famed for whisky, splits into words saying it is not clergy.

clue.text: Hits back in a fight

indicators.note: back says the word for hits is read in reverse

parts.note: raps are sharp hits or knocks

explanation.surface: A boxer returns punches during a bout.
explanation.definitionFit: A spar is a practice bout in boxing, so it is a form of fight.

clue.text: Nevada city giving rise to an outstanding person

indicators.note: rise in a down clue tells us the word goes upward, reading bottom to top

parts.note: a oner is a remarkable or unique person, British slang

explanation.surface: An American city that produces a remarkable individual.
explanation.walkthrough: ONER is British slang for someone or something exceptional.
explanation.definitionFit: Reno is a city in the US state of Nevada, known for casinos and quick divorces.

clue.text: Galatea's lover of whom little account is given

parts.note: A/C is the short form of account

explanation.surface: A mythological suitor about whom scant record survives.
explanation.definitionFit: In Ovid's tale, the shepherd Acis loved the sea nymph Galatea and was crushed by the jealous Polyphemus.

clue.text: As it happens it may be recorded

definitions.text: As it happens it may be recorded

parts.words: As it happens it may be recorded
parts.note: as it happens means by chance, but here means in real time; such a transmission can also be taped

explanation.definitionFit: A programme transmitted while events unfold is shown in real time, and can be taped too.

clue.text: Lionesses can be so quiet

indicators.note: can be says the letters of the word may be arranged into another form

explanation.surface: Big cats on the prowl can move silently.
explanation.definitionFit: Something making no sound is silent, which is to say quiet.
